mentions.name: Forking the Internet
mentions.description: This project reimagines internet technology as a tool for community benefit rather than greed, corporate control, or predation — a 'fork of the internet' oriented toward communal use.
mentions.problem: Internet technology is currently used for greed, corporations, and predation rather than for community.
mentions.source_excerpt: forking the internet. taking internet technology and using if for community rather than (pick 1: greed, corporations, predation).
